SheetIntegrationConfig.title: SheetIntegrationConfig
SheetIntegrationConfig.description: Shared Google Spreadsheet and Apps Script Web App Webhook configuration for SIPELKA Nagekeo (contains no PII).

sheetUrl.description: Google Spreadsheet URL for quick link and gviz fallback.

webhookUrl.description: Google Apps Script Web App /exec endpoint URL.

autoSync.description: Whether data mutations automatically sync to Google Spreadsheet.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who last saved this configuration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration document was last updated.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator access list keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Verified Google account email of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Global application settings; specifically /settings/google_sheet holds the shared Google Spreadsheet integration endpoints.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Administrator registry for Firestore rule-level RBAC.
